name: netstat
summary: Shows network connections and open ports (older tool).
description: Lists active connections, listening ports, the routing table and network statistics. netstat is part of the net-tools package, which is considered obsolete: it is no longer installed by default on recent distributions. Its replacement is ss, which accepts almost the same options (netstat -tulpn becomes ss -tulpn).

options.description: Addresses and ports as numbers, without name resolution (faster).
Shows the PID and program name (sudo to see other users’).

example.output:
Tcp:
    1834 active connection openings
    12 failed connection attempts

examples.explanation: Every listening TCP and UDP port, with the program behind it.
